verdict.rationale: OpenTofu bills itself as a drop-in replacement for Terraform that preserves existing workflows and configurations, and it is backwards-compatible with existing code. It reads `.tf` files alongside `.tofu`, and community users describe migrating client projects as easy, essentially a find-and-replace of terraform with opentofu. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of state-file migration (state compatibility is only implied by the drop-in claim), and a dedicated migration guide or version-compatibility details.
